“小妹，我们回来了！”
“你猜猜我们在黑山打到了什么？”
回到家中。
沈坤满脸神秘。
拿出了身后背着的竹篓，缓缓打开，露出里面躺着的一头体型硕大的青灰色兔子！
“大哥，二哥，你们真在外面打到妖兽了？”
沈鸢看了一眼，难以置信惊呼出声。
“那可不！”
沈坤哈哈一笑，“有妖兽肉滋补，我们便可以尝试运用气血练习蛮牛三式了！”
蛮牛功分为练法蛮牛桩、以及打法蛮牛三式。
蛮牛三式主要是以气血催动，对身体损耗极大。
若是得不到及时补足，身子很容易便会垮掉。
唯有以妖兽肉作为滋补，才能让一位修行者支撑得住修炼蛮牛三式。
黑山村大多数人都不会轻易修习蛮牛三式，因为他们根本承受不起这种巨大的损耗。
通常都只有狩猎一队的成员才会修炼蛮牛三式。
他们外出和妖兽搏杀危险性极大，唯有掌握蛮牛三式才能更好的生存下去。
最重要的是他们能够分到足够的妖兽肉来补足气血损耗。
沈易迟迟没有修炼蛮牛三式，就是因为他们现在还没有猎杀妖兽肉的条件。
但如今，他们有了阴魂木制造出的能够防护全身的护具，倒是有底气去尝试狩猎一些低级妖兽了。

而且听父母说过，到了气血境更深层次的境界，需要更加精纯的气血才能冲关成功。
掌握蛮牛三式则是淬炼气血的关键一环。
它与蛮牛桩相得益彰，两者结合才是完整的蛮牛功。
黑山村大部分人的实力之所以一直停滞不前，很大原因就是没有掌握蛮牛三式。
沈鸢没有高兴多久，很快就变得一副忧心忡忡的模样，抿紧嘴唇道：“大哥，你们面对妖兔的时候肯定很凶险吧。”
“放心，妖兽没我们想象的那么难杀。”
沈坤咧嘴一笑，“大哥刚才一箭就把妖兔给射死了，说到底，它们也只是血肉之躯罢了。”
沈易心中明白，他们能够这么轻松杀死一头妖兽，主要还是装备上的优势。
寻常来说，化妖之后，妖兽本质上已是进行了一次进化，它们具备不俗的防御和生命力，绝非凡物可比。
而阴木长矛可以轻易撕裂妖兽的防御，阴木长弓让他拥有强大的准度。
再加上深乌箭的杀伤力，一整套的装备组合，才是猎杀到妖兽的关键。
若是让村里其他人面对上妖兔，凭借他们的装备水平，估计连妖兔半分皮毛都伤不了。
沈易没有耽误时间。
“起锅烧水，咱们今天也来尝一下妖兽肉是什么滋味！”
“好咧！”
半个时辰后。
眼前的锅炉之中盛满了一块块炖烂的妖兔肉，油水翻滚，馋人的肉香味扑鼻而来。
眼看差不多了。
沈坤立即夹出一块妖兔腿肉，放在了沈易碗里，“大哥，你先吃，尝尝味道！”
沈易没有推辞，夹起腿肉吹凉之后，一口咬下。

"Little sister, we are back!"
"Guess what we hit in Montenegro?"
Return home.
Shen Kun's face was full of mystery.
He took out the bamboo basket he was carrying on his back and slowly opened it, revealing a huge blue-gray rabbit lying inside!
"Brother, second brother, did you really fight the monster outside?"
Shen Yuan took one look and exclaimed in disbelief.
"That's not the case!"
Shen Kun laughed, "With the nourishment of monster meat, we can try to use Qi and blood to practice the three postures of the Bull!"
Man Niu Kung Fu is divided into three types: practicing Man Niu Zhuang and fighting Man Niu.
The three postures of Man Niu are mainly activated by Qi and blood, which causes great damage to the body.
If it is not replenished in time, the body will easily collapse.
Only by using monster meat as nourishment can a practitioner be able to sustain the practice of the three styles of Barbarian Ox.
Most people in Heishan Village will not easily practice the three styles of Barbarian Bull, because they simply cannot afford such huge losses.
Usually only members of the hunting team can practice the three styles of Barbarian Bull.
It is extremely dangerous for them to go out and fight monsters. Only by mastering the three styles of Barbarian Bull can they survive better.
The most important thing is that they can get enough monster meat to make up for the loss of energy and blood.
Shen Yi has not practiced the three styles of Barbarian Bull for a long time because they do not have the conditions to hunt monster meat yet.
But now, they have the protective gear made by the Haunted Soul Wood that can protect their whole body, and they have the confidence to try to hunt some low-level monsters.
Moreover, I heard from my parents that when you reach a deeper level of Qi and Blood realm, you need more pure Qi and blood to successfully pass the level.
Mastering the three postures of Man Niu is a key step in tempering Qi and blood.
It complements the Man Niu Zhuang, and the combination of the two is the complete Man Niu Kung Fu.
The main reason why the strength of most people in Heishan Village has been stagnant is that they have not mastered the three styles of Barbarian Bull.
Shen Yuan was not happy for long, and soon became worried. She pursed her lips and said, "Brother, you must be very dangerous when facing the monster rabbit."
"Don't worry, the monster is not as difficult to kill as we thought."
Shen Kun grinned, "Brother just shot the demon rabbit to death with one arrow. After all, they are just flesh and blood."
Shen Yi knew in his heart that the main reason why they could kill a monster so easily was because of their equipment advantage.
Generally speaking, after transforming into a demon, the demonic beast has essentially evolved. They have excellent defense and vitality, which is unmatched by any other creature.
The Yinwood Spear can easily tear apart the monster's defense, and the Yinwood Longbow gives him powerful accuracy.
Coupled with the lethality of the Deep Black Arrow, a complete equipment combination is the key to hunting monsters.
If other people in the village were to face the Demon Rabbit, with their level of equipment, they probably wouldn't be able to hurt even half of the Demon Rabbit's fur.
Shen Yi didn't waste time.
"Heat a pot of water and let's taste the taste of monster meat today!"
"Okay!"
Half an hour later.
The boiler in front of him was filled with pieces of stewed monster rabbit meat. The oil and water were boiling, and the delicious smell of the meat filled his nostrils.
It's almost done.
Shen Kun immediately took out a piece of demon rabbit leg meat and put it in Shen Yi's bowl, "Brother, you eat it first and taste it!"
Shen Yi didn't refuse. He picked up the leg meat and blew it to cool down before taking a bite.
